TS_CosyVoice3_CrossLingual.description: Cross-language speech synthesis: keep the reference timbre, switch the language.

model.tooltip: The loaded CosyVoice model, from the TS CosyVoice Model Loader node.

reference_audio.tooltip: Voice to clone. Trimmed to 30 seconds and converted to mono 24 kHz; 3-10 seconds of clean speech gives the best timbre.

seed.tooltip: Random seed. Note that -1 does not give you a new take on re-run: ComfyUI caches a node whose inputs did not change. Use the seed widget's control_after_generate: randomize to actually get a different take.

speed.tooltip: Playback speed multiplier applied to the generated speech.

target_language.tooltip: Target language of the text. auto lets the model infer it, which is usually right for unambiguous text.

text.tooltip: The text to speak, written in the target language.

text_normalize.tooltip: Run CosyVoice's text frontend (number and abbreviation expansion). Turn it off when you feed CMU phonemes or special tags that must survive verbatim.

0.tooltip: The generated speech, at the model's own sample rate (24 kHz).

TS_CosyVoice3_Dialog.description: Multi-speaker dialog synthesis with voice cloning (SPEAKER A: ... SPEAKER B: ...).

dialog_text.tooltip: The script, one line per turn, each prefixed with SPEAKER A:, SPEAKER B:, SPEAKER C: or SPEAKER D:. Lines without a recognised prefix, and lines for a speaker with no reference audio, are skipped.

model.tooltip: The loaded CosyVoice model, from the TS CosyVoice Model Loader node.

seed.tooltip: Random seed. Note that -1 does not give you a new take on re-run: ComfyUI caches a node whose inputs did not change. Use the seed widget's control_after_generate: randomize to actually get a different take.

speaker_A_Audio.tooltip: Reference voice for SPEAKER A. 3-10 seconds works best; 30 seconds is the hard limit.

speaker_B_Audio.tooltip: Reference voice for SPEAKER B. 3-10 seconds works best; 30 seconds is the hard limit.

speaker_C_Audio.tooltip: Optional reference voice for SPEAKER C.

speaker_D_Audio.tooltip: Optional reference voice for SPEAKER D.

speed.tooltip: Playback speed multiplier applied to every line of the dialog.

0.tooltip: The full conversation, lines concatenated in script order.

1.tooltip: SPEAKER A alone, silent where the others speak — same length as dialog_audio, so the tracks line up.

2.tooltip: SPEAKER B alone, silent where the others speak.

3.tooltip: SPEAKER C alone; all silence when C never speaks.

4.tooltip: SPEAKER D alone; all silence when D never speaks.

5.tooltip: Short report: duration, number of lines rendered, and any lines that were skipped.

TS_CosyVoice3_Instruct2.description: Generate speech with reference timbre and instruction-guided emotion.

emotion_preset.tooltip: Ready-made delivery preset, read from configs/ts_emotion_presets.json. Pick the custom entry to use the instruct_text field instead.

instruct_text.tooltip: Free-form instruction describing emotion and delivery. Only used when emotion_preset is set to the custom entry.

model.tooltip: The loaded CosyVoice model, from the TS CosyVoice Model Loader node.

reference_audio.tooltip: Voice to clone. Trimmed to 30 seconds and converted to mono 24 kHz; 3-10 seconds of clean speech gives the best timbre.

seed.tooltip: Random seed. Note that -1 does not give you a new take on re-run: ComfyUI caches a node whose inputs did not change. Use the seed widget's control_after_generate: randomize to actually get a different take.

speed.tooltip: Playback speed multiplier applied to the generated speech.

text.tooltip: The text to speak in the reference voice.

text_normalize.tooltip: Run CosyVoice's text frontend (number and abbreviation expansion). Turn it off when you feed CMU phonemes or special tags that must survive verbatim.

0.tooltip: The generated speech, at the model's own sample rate (24 kHz).

TS_CosyVoice3_ModelLoader.description: Load a CosyVoice model with automatic download and caching.

device.tooltip: Preferred compute device, best effort. The CosyVoice runtime places the model itself and uses the GPU when one is available, so this request may not be honoured literally.

download_source.tooltip: Where to download the weights from on first use. If the chosen source fails, the other one is tried automatically.

fp16.tooltip: Load in half precision on supported accelerators to cut VRAM use. Ignored without CUDA.

0.tooltip: The loaded model, to be wired into the pack's synthesis nodes.

TS_CosyVoice3_SaveSpeaker.description: Extract zero-shot speaker features from reference audio and save as a .pt preset.

model.tooltip: The loaded CosyVoice model, from the TS CosyVoice Model Loader node.

reference_audio.tooltip: Voice to clone. Trimmed to 30 seconds and converted to mono 24 kHz; 3-10 seconds of clean speech gives the best timbre.

reference_text.tooltip: What is actually said in the reference audio. Leave it empty to have Whisper transcribe it automatically — an accurate transcript noticeably improves the clone.

speaker_name.tooltip: File name for the preset, without extension. Must be a plain name: no slashes, no '..', none of < > : " / \ | ? *.

0.tooltip: Absolute path the preset was written to.

TS_CosyVoice3_SpeakerInstruct2.description: Synthesize speech using a saved speaker preset (.pt) and an emotion instruction.

emotion_preset.tooltip: Ready-made delivery preset, read from configs/ts_emotion_presets.json. Pick the custom entry to use the instruct_text field instead.

instruct_text.tooltip: Free-form instruction describing emotion and delivery. Only used when emotion_preset is set to the custom entry.

model.tooltip: The loaded CosyVoice model, from the TS CosyVoice Model Loader node.

seed.tooltip: Random seed. Note that -1 does not give you a new take on re-run: ComfyUI caches a node whose inputs did not change. Use the seed widget's control_after_generate: randomize to actually get a different take.

speaker_preset.tooltip: A voice preset saved earlier by TS CosyVoice Save Speaker, read from ComfyUI/models/cosyvoice/speaker/.

speed.tooltip: Playback speed multiplier applied to the generated speech.

text.tooltip: The text to speak in the saved voice.

text_normalize.tooltip: Run CosyVoice's text frontend (number and abbreviation expansion). Turn it off when you feed CMU phonemes or special tags that must survive verbatim.

0.tooltip: The generated speech, at the model's own sample rate (24 kHz).

TS_CosyVoice3_VoiceConversion.description: Convert source audio to sound like the target voice (voice-to-voice).

model.tooltip: The loaded CosyVoice model, from the TS CosyVoice Model Loader node.

pitch_shift_semitones.tooltip: Shift the source pitch before conversion. Useful when source and target sit in different registers — try -12 or +12 when converting between a low and a high voice.

seed.tooltip: Random seed. Note that -1 does not give you a new take on re-run: ComfyUI caches a node whose inputs did not change. Use the seed widget's control_after_generate: randomize to actually get a different take.

source_audio.tooltip: The performance to re-voice. Timing and delivery are kept; only the timbre changes. Long audio is processed in chunks.

speed.tooltip: Playback speed multiplier applied to the generated speech.

target_audio.tooltip: The voice to sound like. Trimmed to 30 seconds and converted to the model's format.

0.tooltip: The re-voiced audio, at the model's own sample rate (24 kHz).
